-- PIVOT base table
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' as apple,'ORANGE' as orange));
-- PIVOT derived table
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
-- PIVOT aggregate alias
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) as total for product in('APPLE' as apple));
-- PIVOT multiple aggregates aliased
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) total,count(amount) cnt for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
-- PIVOT multiple aggregates missing alias restriction
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount),count(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT multiple FOR columns
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for(salesman,product) in(('ALICE','APPLE') aa,('BOB','ORANGE') bo));
-- PIVOT FOR value count mismatch
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for(salesman,product) in(('ALICE') aa));
-- PIVOT parenthesized single FOR
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for(product) in(('APPLE') apple));
-- PIVOT constant expression
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for amount in(100+0 as hundred));
-- PIVOT nonconstant expression restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in(amount as dynamic_value));
-- PIVOT unsupported COVAR_SAMP
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(covar_samp(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT unsupported COVAR_POP
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(covar_pop(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT unsupported CORR
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(corr(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT unsupported AREA_MAX
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(area_max(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT unsupported COLLECT
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(collect(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT XML ANY
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in(any));
-- PIVOT XML subquery
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in(select product from app.pivot_t));
-- PIVOT XML constant list restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE','ORANGE'));
-- PIVOT nonXML ANY restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in(any));
-- PIVOT output nonstar restriction
select salesman,product from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));

-- PIVOT implicit grouping
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
-- PIVOT source alias
select * from app.pivot_t p pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT result alias
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE')) p;
-- PIVOT with CTE
with q as(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) select * from q pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT joined source
select * from(select p.salesman,p.product,p.amount from app.pivot_t p join app.pivot_dim d on p.product=d.product) pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT view
select * from app.pivot_v pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
-- PIVOT ORDER LIMIT
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple)) order by salesman limit 2;
-- PIVOT FOR UPDATE restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE')) for update;
-- UNPIVOT default EXCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
-- UNPIVOT explicit EXCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot exclude nulls(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
-- UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot include nulls(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
-- UNPIVOT parenthesized single names
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount) for(product) in(apple as 'APPLE'));
-- UNPIVOT multiple values
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in((apple,apple_count) as 'APPLE',(orange,orange_count) as 'ORANGE'));
-- UNPIVOT valid multiple FOR aliases
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for(product_metric,count_metric) in((apple,apple_count) as('APPLE_AMOUNT','APPLE_COUNT'),(orange,orange_count) as('ORANGE_AMOUNT','ORANGE_COUNT')));
-- UNPIVOT scalar input multiple FOR aliases restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for(product,region) in(apple as('APPLE','NORTH'),orange as('ORANGE','SOUTH')));
-- UNPIVOT tuple scalar alias
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in((apple,apple_count) as 'APPLE'));
-- UNPIVOT value FOR count mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in(apple as 'APPLE'));
-- UNPIVOT alias count mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for(product,region) in(apple as('APPLE')));
-- UNPIVOT type mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for product in(apple as 'APPLE',note as 'NOTE'));
-- UNPIVOT view
select * from app.wide_v unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT derived table Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,apple,orange from app.wide_t) unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT joined source Pack29 document delta
select * from(select w.salesman,w.apple,w.orange from app.wide_t w join app.pivot_dim d on w.salesman=d.product) unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));

-- UNPIVOT ROWID restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(rowid));
-- UNPIVOT TRXID restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(trxid));
-- UNPIVOT virtual column Pack29 document delta
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(virtual_amount));
-- UNPIVOT with ROLLUP Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by rollup(salesman)) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT with CUBE Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by cube(salesman)) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT GROUPING SETS one item Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by grouping sets((salesman))) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT GROUPING SETS two items Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by grouping sets((salesman),())) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
-- UNPIVOT FOR UPDATE restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange)) for update;
-- PIVOT and UNPIVOT same table reference restriction
select * from app.wide_t pivot(sum(apple) for salesman in('A')) unpivot(value for source_col in(apple));
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT base table
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' as apple,'ORANGE' as orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT derived table
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT aggregate alias
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) as total for product in('APPLE' as apple));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT multiple aggregates aliased
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) total,count(amount) cnt for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT multiple aggregates missing alias restriction
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount),count(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT multiple FOR columns
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for(salesman,product) in(('ALICE','APPLE') aa,('BOB','ORANGE') bo));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT FOR value count mismatch
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot(sum(amount) for(salesman,product) in(('ALICE') aa));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT parenthesized single FOR
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for(product) in(('APPLE') apple));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT constant expression
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for amount in(100+0 as hundred));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT nonconstant expression restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in(amount as dynamic_value));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT unsupported COVAR_SAMP
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(covar_samp(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT unsupported COVAR_POP
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(covar_pop(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT unsupported CORR
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(corr(amount,qty) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT|CALL_PROG_OBJ] -- PIVOT unsupported AREA_MAX
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(area_max(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT|CALL_PROG_OBJ] -- PIVOT unsupported COLLECT
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(collect(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT XML ANY
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in(any));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT XML subquery
select * from(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in(select product from app.pivot_t));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT XML constant list restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot xml(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE','ORANGE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT nonXML ANY restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in(any));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT output nonstar restriction
select salesman,product from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));

----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT implicit grouping
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple,'ORANGE' orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT source alias
select * from app.pivot_t p pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT result alias
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE')) p;
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT with CTE
with q as(select salesman,product,amount from app.pivot_t) select * from q pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT joined source
select * from(select p.salesman,p.product,p.amount from app.pivot_t p join app.pivot_dim d on p.product=d.product) pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT view
select * from app.pivot_v pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT ORDER LIMIT
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE' apple)) order by salesman limit 2;
----------
[SELECT|QUERY_LOCK] -- PIVOT FOR UPDATE restriction
select * from app.pivot_t pivot(sum(amount) for product in('APPLE')) for update;
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT default EXCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT explicit EXCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot exclude nulls(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS
select * from app.wide_t unpivot include nulls(amount for product in(apple as 'APPLE',orange as 'ORANGE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT parenthesized single names
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount) for(product) in(apple as 'APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT multiple values
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in((apple,apple_count) as 'APPLE',(orange,orange_count) as 'ORANGE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT valid multiple FOR aliases
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for(product_metric,count_metric) in((apple,apple_count) as('APPLE_AMOUNT','APPLE_COUNT'),(orange,orange_count) as('ORANGE_AMOUNT','ORANGE_COUNT')));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT scalar input multiple FOR aliases restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for(product,region) in(apple as('APPLE','NORTH'),orange as('ORANGE','SOUTH')));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT tuple scalar alias
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in((apple,apple_count) as 'APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT value FOR count mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot((amount,cnt) for product in(apple as 'APPLE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT alias count mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for(product,region) in(apple as('APPLE')));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT type mismatch
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for product in(apple as 'APPLE',note as 'NOTE'));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT view
select * from app.wide_v unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT derived table Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,apple,orange from app.wide_t) unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT joined source Pack29 document delta
select * from(select w.salesman,w.apple,w.orange from app.wide_t w join app.pivot_dim d on w.salesman=d.product) unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange));

----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT ROWID restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(rowid));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT TRXID restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(trxid));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT virtual column Pack29 document delta
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(value for source_col in(virtual_amount));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT with ROLLUP Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by rollup(salesman)) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT with CUBE Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by cube(salesman)) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT GROUPING SETS one item Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by grouping sets((salesman))) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT] -- UNPIVOT GROUPING SETS two items Pack29 document delta
select * from(select salesman,sum(apple) apple,sum(orange) orange from app.wide_t group by grouping sets((salesman),())) unpivot(value for product in(apple,orange));
----------
[SELECT|QUERY_LOCK] -- UNPIVOT FOR UPDATE restriction
select * from app.wide_t unpivot(amount for product in(apple,orange)) for update;
----------
[SELECT] -- PIVOT and UNPIVOT same table reference restriction
select * from app.wide_t pivot(sum(apple) for salesman in('A')) unpivot(value for source_col in(apple));
